title: Farewells
label: ch:farewells
canDo: I can end a Hindi conversation politely and choose a farewell that fits the situation.

payoff.summary: Complete HI-C04-practice, the canonical closing checkpoint, and demonstrate the chapter promise: end a Hindi conversation politely and choose a farewell that fits the situation.
payoff.note: Chapter 4 is schema-v2, so the payoff is atom-scored: HI-C04-practice assesses 4 of the chapter's 6 atoms — the three farewells (phir milenge, kal milte hain, chalta hun) and the register choice the checkpoint introduces. The building blocks phir and milenge are rehearsed inside phir milenge and scored in their own lessons.
